Ivy (CS): Heads-up: a subset of Dedicated EU tenants experienced delayed embedding ingestion this morning. Some customers reported stale search hits. Opening thread to coordinate customer-facing updates and mitigation.

Marco (SRE): Investigating. Initial trace shows autoscaler failed to replace a crashed embed-writer pod due to a bad readiness probe change in the last deploy; concurrency dropped and backlog accumulated.

Jin (Eng): Confirmed 1 the readiness probe timeout was shortened too aggressively; kubelet marked pod unready but autoscaler didn't spin up replacement because probe returned transient pass then fail. We reverted probe at 04:05 UTC.

Felix (Support): Affected tickets: ONB-4001, CUST-902, CUST-919. Customers asking if vectors were lost and what we're doing about renewals.

Marco (SRE): No data loss. We retried backlog processing after the revert; most tenants caught up by 04:40 UTC. Added alert: embed-backlog > 30 for >10m pages infra.

Ivy (CS): Comms plan: 1) immediate short note to affected customers; 2) tailored RCA + timeline for renewals; 3) offer a renewal mitigation package (one-month credit or priority onboarding session).

Jin (Eng): Draft short status: "We saw delayed embedding updates for a small group of EU dedicated tenants between ~03:5004:05 UTC due to an autoscaler/readiness probe interaction after a deploy. We reverted the probe change and reprocessed backfill; embeddings are current. No data was lost. Reply if you still see issues"

Ivy (CS): Good. For renewal-risk accounts offer the one-month credit + a 1:1 ops session; for trials offer 72-hour extension. I'll draft templates and send at 10:00 UTC.

Felix (Support): Posting short note to tickets now. Will attach backlog job IDs once Marco provides them.

NotifyBot: Probe revert deployed at 04:05 UTC; backfill started at 04:08 UTC; system health green.

Marco (SRE): Job IDs attached to tickets. Preventive steps: revert aggressive probe changes from CI templates, add canary that verifies new readiness probe under load, and block deploys if embed queue > 10.

Ivy (CS): Approving compensation plan. I'll prepare exec-level RCA for impacted renewals and schedule two office hours for follow-up.

Jin (Eng): Note for RCA: root cause = probe timeout change + flaky readiness behavior; impact window ~15m; mitigation = revert + backfill + alerting; prevention = probe linting, canary smoke, deploy gating.

Felix (Support): Tickets updated with short status and compensation promise. Waiting on email templates for execs.

Ivy (CS): Will post final sends and attendee list here after 10:00 UTC. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
